opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
However, in the supplementary statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., the prosecutrix improved their earlier version and alleged kidnapping and rape against the appellant.
There are contradictions between the FIR and statements of prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C.
